title: Dealer API: allow pausing offers whose terms are no longer priced
description: Since 30,000 km was withdrawn for some segments, every save of an affected offer throws UnsupportedTerms while repricing, so dealers cannot even pause those offers (they stay live with a rate we no longer stand behind). Update now lets dealers pause such offers. Test included.

defects.explanation: The exception aborts the save, but it is only reported and the endpoint returns 200 with the in-memory (unsaved) attributes, so the dealer sees status "paused" while the offer stays active and unchanged in the database.
